rationale: A provides the more actionable and auditable design: preregistered role constraints, thresholded multidimensional evidence, an explicit conflict register, evidence-quality labels, assumptions, revisit triggers, provenance, and configuration hashes. B adds a valuable deployment pilot and stronger examples of methodological conflict, but A more completely preserves the decision context needed six months later. A does contain a technical error—interior points of a convex hull are not necessarily Pareto-dominated—and both responses overinterpret overlapping confidence intervals rather than recommending paired intervals on differences; these issues do not outweigh A's stronger decision-record structure.
